meta.source: Sampled from deongelooflijke.substack.com (theme CSS variables), the podcast artwork and the EO wordmark, 7 Nov 2026.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Page background. The Substack's web_bg_color; in dark, a warm near-black.

tokens.name: parchment-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, search field, table stripes (Substack background_contrast_1).

tokens.name: parchment-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed surfaces, bar-chart tracks (Substack background_contrast_2).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers (Substack color_theme_detail). Never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 9.4:1 on parchment light, 13.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, durations, captions. 5.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. Replaces Substack's #757575, which is only 3.6:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The ground of the saint-with-headphones artwork. Fills, chart bars and badges with ink-engraving text on top; not for text on parchment.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold when it must be text or a thin line on parchment (4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: engraving
tokens.usage: The dark-brown engraving ink of the artwork. Footer and hero ground; text on gold (5.8:1).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: EO / wordmark violet, the one accent: links, focus rings, the active filter, highlighted search hits. 4.6:1 on parchment; lifted to #b88cff in dark (7:1).

tokens.name: violet-deep
tokens.usage: Filled violet buttons and chips with white text (6.8:1).

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: The white of the halo and headphones; text on violet and engraving.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, chip padding top/bottom.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the round artwork medallion.
